definitions.full: H658. Ephec Dammiym דַּמִּים אֶ֫פֶס proper name, of a location in Judah, approximately 16 miles southwest of Jerusalem, called in 1Chr 11:13 דַּמִּים מַּס , (meaning unknown; Lag BN 76 on basis of MSS. of ᵐ5 would read מים ספר edge or brink () of water ; but such a pronounced Aramaism is not probable), only 1Sam 17:1 .
definitions.rootNote: from 657 and the plural of 1818 ; boundary of blood-drops;

occurrences.englishText: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle; and they were gathered together at Socoh, which belongs to Judah, and encamped between Socoh and Azekah, in Ephesdammim.
